evidence: PRISM provides daily, monthly and annual gridded climate datasets and associated metadata/web services. Exact variables/subsets consumed by paper 716's case study are not reconstructed in Stage 2.
The current NTL-LTER portal documents over 300 EDI packages spanning core limnology, meteorology, high-frequency buoy, regional-lake, GIS and other long-term ecological datasets.

Independent scholarly Data Availability statements identify Zenodo 2559313 as an archived example/sample SPCAM dataset associated with Rasp et al. (2018); the much larger full raw/preprocessed SPCAM collections are separate resources available elsewhere/on request.
